# What will your course launch actually earn after refunds, fees and ads?

> Course launch revenue calculator. Enter your email list, conversion rates, price, refunds, platform and processor fees, affiliate commissions and ad spend. See net profit, the break-even list size and what a weaker launch costs. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
